flags16.name: Placement Flags
flags16.tooltip: Bit 0 set when the slot holds a placement (0 in empty slots). Tested by FUN_18006e638.

uint16.name: Palette Index
uint16.tooltip: 0x46 in three placements of the same object type, 0xFFFF in empty slots. Probably the palette (object type) index.

point3.name: Position
point3.tooltip: World position of the placement. Matches the position of the object.

uint16.name: Unknown 2E
uint16.tooltip: 1 and 2 in the placements 1 and 2. Maybe its own index or an order.

float32.name: Shape Radius
float32.tooltip: Zone shape: radius or width (box set to 0.1 in Forge reads 0.1466).

enum8.name: Shape Kind
enum8.tooltip: 0 none, 3 box. Same codes as the multiplayer block of the datum (+0x10).

int8.name: Spawn Sequence
int8.tooltip: Forge spawn sequence (10 reads 0x0A). Signed is assumed.

uint16.name: Gametype Label
uint16.tooltip: 0xFFFF by default. Probably the gametype label index (Forge basic has no labels to test).

flags8.name: Forge Flags
flags8.tooltip: Measured in Forge and in a local custom game. Symmetry bits: 0x04 symmetric, 0x08 asymmetric, 0x0C both. Physics bits: 0x00 normal, 0x40 fixed, 0xC0 phased. Bits 0 and 4 not measured.

uint8.name: Team
uint8.tooltip: Forge team (8 neutral, 0 red). Same codes as the multiplayer block of the datum (+0x19).
